# FishHist: Southeast Fisheries Management History Data Package

## Overview

Fisheries management history data are essential for properly
understanding trends in fishery-dependent data as well as results from
stock assessment models. Federal regulations are published under Federal
Registrar (FR) notices. In the Southeast US region under the Southeast
Data Assessment and Review (SEDAR) process, management histories for an
upcoming stock assessment were previously provided on a species by
species basis, and often lacked consistent documentation to the FR
notice where the rule was published. To standardize the collection of
these data, a Southeast Fisheries Management History Database was build
and populated for Federal Management Plans (FMPs) throughout the Gulf of
America, South Atlantic, and U.S. Caribbean regions. Compilation of this
database was a collaborative process involving South Atlantic Fishery
Management Council (SAFMC), Gulf Fishery Management Council (GFMC),
Southeast Regional Office (SERO), and Southeast Fisheries Science Center
(SEFSC) personnel. Funding for this project beginning in 2020 was made
possible through NOAA’s Fisheries Information System (FIS) program. In
total, this project entered FRs from 16 FMPs within the Southeast
region.

Each record within the database contains a regulation from a FR notice,
however in this raw format, the individual management actions are
disjointed because each rule often overwrites or changes an existing
rule. The FishHist data set within this package contains an
analysis-ready Fisheries Management History data set that links and
reconciles overlapping actions that modify or replace prior rules over
time. Functions built within this package assist in visualizing and
analyzing fisheries management history data for science and management.

## Publications

Sagarese, S.R., Atkinson, S., Malone, G., Rios, A.B., McCarthy, K.J.,
Matter, V.M. 2025. Synthesis of Management Histories for Gulf of America
Reef Fishes through 2024. NOAA Tech. Memo. NMFS-SEFSC-793 DOI:
10.25923/h0jt-xe51

# Package index

## Functions

The functions built within this package to visualize and format
fisheries management data

- [`expand_status()`](https://supreme-broccoli-2mkenmw.pages.github.io/reference/expand_status.md)
  : Expand management status
- [`gantt_FMP()`](https://supreme-broccoli-2mkenmw.pages.github.io/reference/gantt_FMP.md)
  : Gantt chart of FMPs
- [`plot_mcats_sector()`](https://supreme-broccoli-2mkenmw.pages.github.io/reference/plot_mcats_sector.md)
  : FMP plot by sector
- [`plot_mcats_spp()`](https://supreme-broccoli-2mkenmw.pages.github.io/reference/plot_mcats_spp.md)
  : FMP plot for managed species
- [`plot_species_timeline()`](https://supreme-broccoli-2mkenmw.pages.github.io/reference/plot_species_timeline.md)
  : Timeline visual
- [`process_closures()`](https://supreme-broccoli-2mkenmw.pages.github.io/reference/process_closures.md)
  : Process Closure-related management types
- [`tab_definitions()`](https://supreme-broccoli-2mkenmw.pages.github.io/reference/tab_definitions.md)
  : Definitions Table

## Datasets

Example processed analysis-ready Southeast Fisheries Management Dataset
that can be used for practicing use of the package’s functions

- [`fishhist`](https://supreme-broccoli-2mkenmw.pages.github.io/reference/fishhist.md)
  : Management History data through 2025
